title: Aquila X200 Water Purifier - User Handbook
note: Synthetic evaluation document. One entry per page; the expected pages in the datasets refer to this order.

pages.heading: 1. Overview and specifications
lines: The Aquila X200 is a countertop water purifier for household drinking water.
Maximum operating pressure: 6 bar. Minimum operating pressure: 1.5 bar.
Maximum inlet water temperature: 40 degrees Celsius.
Power consumption: 45 W. Supply voltage: 230 V AC.
Weight: 3.2 kg. Dimensions: 30 x 15 x 40 cm.
The manufacturer grants a warranty of 24 months from the date of purchase.

pages.heading: 2. Safety instructions
lines: Always disconnect the unit from the mains before servicing or replacing the cartridge.
Never operate the purifier with inlet water hotter than 40 degrees Celsius.
Use only genuine F-200 filter cartridges supplied by the manufacturer.
Keep the power cable away from wet surfaces and from the water connections.
The child lock is activated by holding the Lock button for 3 seconds.

pages.heading: 3. Installation procedure
lines: Before you start you need a Phillips screwdriver, four M6 screws and an adjustable wrench.
1. Turn off the cold water supply at the isolation valve.
2. Mount the wall bracket with the four M6 screws, 120 mm above the sink.
3. Connect the inlet hose to the cold water valve using the 1/2 inch fitting.
4. Connect the outlet tube to the faucet adapter and hand tighten.
5. Insert the F-200 filter cartridge and twist it clockwise until it clicks.
6. Open the water supply slowly and check every connection for leaks.
7. Flush the system by running 5 liters of water through it, about 10 minutes.
8. Plug in the unit and press the Start button.

pages.heading: 4. Maintenance
lines: Replace the filter cartridge every 6 months or after 2000 liters, whichever comes first.
Clean the housing every month with a soft damp cloth. Do not use solvents.
Descale the unit every 3 months with a citric acid solution.
After replacing the cartridge, hold the Reset button for 5 seconds to reset the filter counter.

pages.heading: 5. Troubleshooting
lines: Symptom: low water flow. Cause: clogged filter cartridge. Fix: replace the cartridge.
Symptom: red LED blinking. Cause: filter cartridge expired. Fix: replace the cartridge and reset the counter.
Symptom: water leaking at the inlet. Cause: loose fitting. Fix: tighten the fitting a quarter turn.
Symptom: unusual noise. Cause: air in the system. Fix: flush the system for 2 minutes.

pages.heading: 6. Warranty and support
lines: The warranty is void if cartridges that are not genuine F-200 cartridges are used.
Customer support is available Monday to Friday from 9:00 to 17:00.
Products may be returned within 30 days of purchase in their original packaging.
